contributor to MP

According to the ODNB she contributed unidentified Lives of the Saints to MP;  she married (1880) the Rev. William Henry Ady (d. 1915), Rector of Edgcote and son of the Ven. William Brice Ady, Archdeacon of Colchester. His sister Jane was married to the Rev. John Trant Bramston.
